question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.

Entire
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Entire"** means something that is whole, complete, or having all its parts. (पूरा)

 
 
• **Example:** The entire class attended the lecture.
 
 
 
• **"Incomplete"** refers to something that is not whole or finished, lacking some parts. (अधूरा)
 
 
• **Example:** The project remained incomplete due to lack of resources.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the opposite of **'Entire'** is **'Incomplete'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Ingress** (प्रवेश): The action or fact of going in or entering.

 
 
• **Example:** The ingress of water into the building caused significant damage.
 
 
 
• **Thorough** (पूरी तरह): Complete with regard to every detail.
 
 
• **Example:** She made a thorough review of the report before submission.
 
 
 
• **Undivided** (अविभाजित): Not separated into parts or shares.
 
 
• **Example:** His undivided attention was on the speaker throughout the seminar.
